@graph.name: esa-frontiers-figures: code and data behind the figures of 'Rethinking Interoperability for AI-Driven Earth Intelligence'
@graph.description: Reproducibility package for the ESA Frontiers of Science talk (30 September 2026): one folder per slide figure with scripts, a README, and either small derived data or a script that fetches the source data. Beni lowlands analyses run on WGS84 HEALPix with healpix-connector. Record-level locations of threatened species are deliberately not included.
